{{Quote|Sorry. No blaze of glory for you, Jedi. We have too much to discuss.|Sivill, to [[Dar'Nala]]|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref>}}
'''Sivill''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who commanded a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith warship]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] in the period just after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. He led the boarding party that captured [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dar'Nala]] during a skirmish with a [[Republic transport ship]] in the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]].

==Biography==
Sivill was in command of a Sith warship during the [[Great Galactic War]]. After the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] was signed, Sivill was given secret orders from [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] to attack the [[Envoy (Republic transport ship)|''Envoy'']], which was carrying [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Satele Shan]] and [[Dar'Nala]] in the Kuat sector of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and frame it as a Republic first strike. Sivill made an announcement over the ship's intercom that they were under attack by a Republic ship and a boarding party had to be dispatched in order to take at least one of the Jedi alive.

[[File:SivillInterrogatesDarNala-NewGalacticOrder.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sivill interrogates Master Dar'Nala]]
Sivill led a group of [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial commandos]] aboard the transport, some of which attacked and were killed by Satele Shan. Meanwhile Sivill and the other commandos faced off against Dar'Nala and mockingly told her that she would not go down in a "blaze of glory" as they had too much to discuss, before trapping her in a net. Dar'Nala called to Shan to run and inform the council of the attack. Shan fled, and Dar'Nala remained Sivill's prisoner.

Later, Sivill interrogated the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] Jedi Master in the detention center of an Imperial transport. During the interrogation, he subjected Dar'Nala to [[Torture/Legends#Electrocution|electric shock treatment]] in an attempt to force her to admit that the ''Envoy'' fired on the Sith warship first. Dar'Nala refused to cooperate, and he left saying he would give her one last chance when he came back.

Dar'Nala later helped [[Braden|another Sith captive]] escape so he could tell the Republic the truth. Sivill was furious, and since Dar'Nala had already refused to cooperate, he had her executed... or so he thought.

Sivill was later killed in a bombing on Korriban, which [[Darth Angral]] later realized that Baras had been behind.

==Equipment and gear==
Sivill carried a type of blaster that fired a net, which he used to capture Dar'Nala.
